dog.description_text:
Bonnie

Bonnie is a working breed, and she needs more than a backyard and a few quick walks. She needs exercise, structure, mental stimulation and continued training. Give this girl a job and something to work on—she is SMART and loves to learn.
Her family has put a tremendous amount of work into her, and it shows. ❤️ She has learned sit and down, is working on recall, and is getting pretty darn good with her crate training.
And at home? Bonnie has a completely different side.
